title: PowerDNS Authoritative Server
description: Configuration for PowerDNS, the pdns4 pool target designate provisions zones into. Only the fields here are settable on a Composition; everything else uses the chart defaults in values.yaml. The API key designate authenticates with is NOT settable and is not a chart default: a Job mints it into a Secret on first install and leaves it alone afterwards, so it is never rendered into a manifest or committed to this repository. Deploy all the OpenStack component blueprints into one namespace to form a complete install.

powerdns.title: PowerDNS replicas
powerdns.description: Authoritative servers. All replicas read the same gmysql database, so they serve identical zone data.

webserver-allow-from.title: API clients allowed
webserver-allow-from.description: CIDRs permitted to reach the HTTP API on 8081. The default 0.0.0.0/0 is permissive because a pod CIDR is not knowable from a chart; narrow it to your cluster's pod CIDR. designate-worker is the only client that needs it.
